name: Libya
description: Libya from Greek Cyrene and Roman Leptis Magna to the Ottomans, Italy, a kingdom, Gaddafi's rule and the war since 2011.

checkpoints.name: Greeks, Romans and Arabs
checkpoints.note: The Sahara's rock art, Greek Cyrene, Phoenician Tripoli and Roman Leptis Magna. Arabs came in the 600s.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman and Italian rule
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans ruled from 1551. Italy invaded in 1911, and Omar Mukhtar led the resistance.

checkpoints.name: Kingdom and Gaddafi
checkpoints.note: Libya became independent in 1951 under King Idris. Oil was found, and Gaddafi ruled from 1969.

checkpoints.name: War
checkpoints.note: Gaddafi fell in 2011. Libya has been split between rival governments, and the floods of 2023 destroyed much of Derna.
